# Sibi Narendran

> Sibi Narendran is the founder of Dooza (https://dooza.ai), an AI-native company that builds AI employees for small businesses. He is an entrepreneur from Chennai, India.

## Facts
- Founder of Dooza (founded 2024): AI employees for small businesses (Dooza Crew).
- Founder of Interio Square (founded 2023 at age 18), an interior design business nearing $2M in yearly sales.
- Took over digital marketing for his father's company Suresh Timbers at 16 (2021), growing sales from about $10,000 a month to about $130K a month.
- Studied BBA at Loyola College, Chennai and IESEG School of Management, France; dropped out in his first semester in France to scale his business.
- Taught himself AI and coding in a month-long self-study stint in Bangalore before starting Dooza.

## Writing
- [Every small business will hire AI employees](https://www.sibinarendran.com/ai-employees-every-small-business): the thesis behind Dooza, the Klarna warning, three dated predictions.
- [AI 2027 vs reality: a live tracker](https://www.sibinarendran.com/ai-2027-tracker): every dated AI 2027 prediction next to what really happened, with sources.
- [AI 2029: a scenario written in October 2026](https://www.sibinarendran.com/ai-2029): dated predictions for 2026-2028, graded as they come due.
- [We may not need a 3D world to begin building AGI](https://www.sibinarendran.com/blog/text-first-agi): a thesis for text-first worlds where AI agents learn from consequences.
